editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate exam by AWS with verified study guidance covering monitoring, reliability, automation, security.
editorial.overview: The AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate certification, administered by AWS, validates operational expertise in cloud environments. It evaluates skills across five distinct domains, including monitoring, reliability, automation, security, and networking features. The exam has a price of $150.0 and requires candidates to achieve a passing score of 720 points for full certification.
editorial.who_should_take: Cloud operators and system administrators with hands-on experience managing and maintaining AWS resources. Candidates should understand how to deploy applications, configure networking features, and manage security compliance tools across cloud environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official AWS documentation on CloudWatch, IAM, and AWS Backup to build a solid base of knowledge across all tested objectives. Practice setting up metrics, alarms, and dashboards. Gain practical experience automating resource provisioning and managing cross-account observability features to prepare effectively for the 130 minutes exam.

domain_guidance.summary: Covers implementing metrics, alarms, and filters by using AWS monitoring services, identifying and remediating issues using availability metrics, and optimizing performance for compute, storage, and database resources across cloud environments and architectures.

This specific domain focuses heavily on implementing scalability, elasticity, highly available and resilient environments, and establishing reliable backup and restore strategies for cloud infrastructure to ensure continuous business operations without any disruption.

Deals with provisioning and maintaining cloud resources, and automating the management of existing resources across AWS environments to streamline operational workflows and reduce manual administrative overhead during deployments.
study_focus: Automate the management of existing resources

domain_guidance.summary: This section covers implementing and managing security and compliance tools and policies, as well as strategies to protect data and infrastructure effectively against potential vulnerabilities, threats, and unauthorized access.
study_focus: Implement strategies to protect data and infrastructure

domain_guidance.summary: This final domain involves implementing and optimizing networking features and connectivity, configuring domains, DNS services, and content delivery, and troubleshooting network connectivity issues across distributed cloud infrastructure architectures.
study_focus: Configure domains, DNS services, and content delivery

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully during the 130 minutes allowed for the exam. Read each question carefully, and check with AWS for the current certification path and testing policies.

faq.question_title: What is the passing score for the exam?
faq.answer_text: The passing score required to successfully pass the official AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate certification exam is established at a minimum threshold of 720 points for all test takers seeking certification.

faq.question_title: How long is the exam duration?
faq.answer_text: Candidates taking the official certification test are given a total allocated duration of 130 minutes to complete all questions presented during the testing session administered by the testing provider.

faq.question_title: What is the price of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The standard registration price required for taking this specific AWS certification exam is set at $150.0, which is payable directly to the official testing provider when you schedule your appointment.

faq.question_title: How many domains are covered on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The thorough exam evaluates candidate knowledge across five distinct domains, including monitoring, reliability, provisioning, security, and networking features required for modern cloud operations in enterprise environments.

methodology.summary: This page was meticulously built using official AWS exam documentation, verified domain weights, and official guides for CloudWatch, IAM, and AWS Backup.
